items.title: Hardbans remain active until staff remove them
items.body: Staff-issued hardbans on this server disconnect affected users and reject matching reconnects until a staff member removes the ban. This item is limited to this Replit host.

items.title: Database reset behavior depends on the service
items.body: In the BonziWORLD.kr/Replit code here, /resetdatabase requires a second confirmation within 60 seconds, creates a backup snapshot, clears application data including hardban and moderation records, then restarts the server. Reconnecting users can quickly create fresh records. This command does not call a reset operation on bonzi.app or bwiworld-production-up.railway.app; their reset procedures and data-sharing setup could not be verified from this workspace.

items.title: BonziNEWS is live
items.body: This feed will carry updates for bonziworld.kr, bonzi.app, bwiworld-production-up.railway.app, and other BonziWORLD services. Godword and Kingword announcements can identify the affected service, but the secret word itself is never published.
